The '''Farstey system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farstey/Legends|Farstey]].
